title: Maize — Varieties, Seed Rate, Spacing and Sowing
content:
MAIZE VARIETIES FOR KARNATAKA:
Hybrids (kharif): NK-6240, CP-818, DKC-9108, Pioneer 30V92, Kaveri KMH-3712, Dekalb 900M.
Hybrids (rabi): NK-6240, 30B07, Super-900M.
OPV varieties: Nithyashree, Ganga Hybrid-5.
Note: Hybrids give 20-30% higher yield than OPVs but seed cost is higher.

SEED RATE:
Hybrids: 18-22 kg/ha. OPV: 20-25 kg/ha.

SEED TREATMENT (Recommended):
1. Thiram 3g/kg + Imidacloprid 70 WS @ 7g/kg seed.
2. Azospirillum + PSB @ 600g/ha each as biofertilizer.
3. Trichoderma viride 4g/kg seed.

SPACING:
- Row spacing: 60 cm (kharif) or 75 cm (rabi/irrigated).
- Plant spacing: 20 cm within row.
- Population: 66,666 plants/ha at 60×25 cm, 55,555 plants/ha at 60×30 cm.

SOWING DEPTH: 4-5 cm (red soil), 3 cm (black soil). Avoid very deep sowing.

SEASON:
Kharif: June-July (sow with first rains). Rabi: October-November (dry sowing with pre-irrigation). Summer: February (irrigated only).

LAND PREPARATION:
- 2-3 plowings + harrowing. 
- Ridges and furrows: furrow width 30 cm, ridge height 20-25 cm for drainage.
- Apply FYM 10 t/ha + vermicompost 2.5 t/ha at last plowing.

POPULATION MANAGEMENT:
- Thin to 1 plant/hill at 10-12 DAS if excess germination.
- Gap fill within 15 DAS to maintain uniform population.
